## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name uses `feature/`, `bugfix/`, `patch/`, or `hotfix/`
- [ ] `make ci` passes
- [ ] New developer dependencies are installed by `make setup`, checked by `make doctor`, and documented in `docs/developer-setup.md`
- [ ] README and docs updated (Mermaid for diagrams)
- [ ] ADR added if a significant decision was made
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data, or Terraform state committed
